statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Sanctioning Russia Act (Executive Calendar)
statements.title: Sanctioning Russia Act (Executive Calendar)
sentences: So I rise here today to, yes, pay tribute to Lindsey Graham, but to also call on my colleagues to help us carry on one of his greatest efforts: ending Putin's barbaric and unjust war against sovereign Ukraine.
For more than 4 years, the Ukrainian people have shown extraordinary resilience and resolve.
In 2022, Putin thought he could seize eastern Ukraine in days.
Putin has made clear his intentions to push beyond Ukraine and into NATO territory.
These were deliberate--deliberate--provocations to test NATO's resolve.
Putin seeks to push deeper into Europe to see just how far he can go before we push back.
That is why the United States and our allies must raise the stakes through tougher sanctions and a stronger United States' deterrence posture along NATO's eastern flank.
Their actions remind us that NATO's strength lies in that unity and readiness.
This is the path forward, a stronger more capable NATO prepared to deter but also to defeat any threat.
But make no mistake on this: Putin understands only one language, and that is power.
The surest road to peace in Europe lies in NATO's strength and Ukraine's survival.
The Kremlin's war machine runs on money it makes from selling cheap oil and gas to countries like China and India and Brazil.
They cannot keep fueling Putin's war and expect business as usual with us, with the United States.
This legislation would impose mandatory sanctions on Russia's political leadership, financial institutions, energy sector, and sanctions evasion networks.
By employing targeted tariffs, this policy would pressure the world's largest purchasers of Russian energy to reduce their dependence on Moscow.
The Sanctioning Russia Act is the sledgehammer that we need, decisive economic pressure that cripples Putin's lifeline, and it hastens the day that his war with Ukraine is finally going to end.
Let us bring freedom and security to the people of Ukraine.
I was proud to be an early supporter of the bill, and I am proud to support this updated version now.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SCARPER RIDGE GOLDEN GATE NATIONAL RECREATION AREA BOUNDARY ADJUSTMENT ACT
statements.title: SCARPER RIDGE GOLDEN GATE NATIONAL RECREATION AREA BOUNDARY ADJUSTMENT ACT
sentences: The SAVE America Act is simple: It requires proof of citizenship to register to vote and requires a photo ID when you go to cast a ballot.
A recent CBS News poll shows that 80 percent of Americans support requiring a photo ID to vote, and that includes 65 percent of Democrats.
A Pew Research Center poll finds that 83 percent of voters support photo ID at the polls, and that includes 71 percent of Democrats.
Sixty-six percent of Americans support requiring documents showing proof of citizenship in order to register to vote.
Proof of citizenship is required when you apply for government benefits.
Americans show photo ID to drive a car, to pick up their kids early from school, to check into a hotel, to purchase cold medicine at the pharmacy, to board a plane, and to get a library card.
In fact, Senator Schumer recently announced that Democrats do support voter ID.
He offered a clean, basic photo ID bill, just a simple requirement to show voter ID at the polls: a driver's license, a military ID, a Tribal ID, or a passport.
America's election integrity is on the line.
The SAVE America Act is a commonsense solution, proof of citizenship to register and photo ID to vote.
I urge my colleagues to support the SAVE America Act.

statements.title: COMMERCE, JUSTICE, SCIENCE; ENERGY AND WATER DEVELOPMENT; AND INTERIOR AND ENVIRONMENT APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: Mr. President, since December 28, Iranian civilians have taken to the streets to protest the bleak economic conditions and the daily hardships imposed on their families by the Iranian regime.
I stand in solidarity with the people of Iran.
And the people of Iran deserve liberty.
In an attempt to silence dissent and conceal its abuses, Iranian authorities have shut down the internet and the phone service.
Peaceful protesters have been met with lethal force.
This level of violence against Iran's own people is indefensible.
These measures send a clear message: The United States will not ignore the suffering of the Iranian people, and the exploitation of the Iranian people must end.
The newly imposed 25-percent tariffs on countries doing business with Iran are designed to strike at the economic lifelines that enable this repression.
Some of Iran's largest trading partners unsurprisingly are our adversaries.
It is both in the interest of our national security and in the interest of the Iranian people to hold these enablers accountable.
The courage of the Iranian people deserves nothing less.

sentences: Mr. President, today, the U.S. Senate will vote on my resolution to overturn the EPA's waiver for California's Advanced Clean Trucks.
This heavyhanded regulation imposes unrealistic emissions requirements for heavy-duty trucks and heavy-duty diesel engines.
Now, I am not here today to disparage electric vehicles, and I am certainly not here to discourage the manufacturing and the purchasing of EVs either.
I believe in the power of America's free markets, and I believe we should allow the markets to determine the viability of clean trucks.
Hard-working families are already dealing with the high cost of everyday goods and services, and they cannot afford this regulation.
I will be proud for this body to vote on and pass my resolution, which is a commonsense step to keep government overreach at bay, protect consumers, and support America's free markets.

statements.title: FACT ACT
sentences: Madam President, last week, my bill, the Foreign Adversary Communications Transparency Act, or the FACT Act, cleared the Commerce Committee unanimously.
Congress must anticipate the threats, and we must work together to curb the malign influence of foreign adversaries like communist China, Russia, Iran, and North Korea.
Huawei, a Chinese-owned telecommunications giant, is one of the leading producers of cell phone network equipment.
Their investigations found that Huawei could secretly access mobile phone networks around the world through backdoors, unbeknownst to carriers.

Despite being based in China and having deep connections to the Chinese Communist Party, as confirmed by U.S. intelligence communities, the company continues to refuse to acknowledge the Chinese Government's influence.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PFML Tax Credit Extension and Enhancement Act (Executive Calendar)
statements.title: PFML Tax Credit Extension and Enhancement Act (Executive Calendar)
sentences: It may be true that we disagree on some big issues--important issues--but behind the headlines and the social media posts, there are many things that Americans agree on, and one of those is paid family and medical leave.
The Pew Research Center found that the vast majority of Americans support paid parental leave--up to 82 percent.

And 85 percent of Americans say people should receive paid leave to deal with their own serious health conditions, and 67 percent say they should receive leave to care for a family member with a serious health condition.
We rarely see Americans nowadays so united on other issues, but it is for good reason that Republicans and Democrats come together on paid family leave.
That is why I spearheaded our Nation's first-ever Federal family leave policy in 2017 with Senator Angus King.
As part of the 2017 Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, we passed a paid family and medical leave tax credit that encourages businesses to offer leave to their employees.
Employers are able to receive the tax credit if they voluntarily offer up to 12 weeks of paid leave.
Our credit increases access to paid leave without penalizing small businesses with limited resources, like a government entitlement program or a mandate from the government would.
Our bipartisan, bicameral bill supports additional options for financing paid leave, such as paid family leave insurance.
It also allows employers to begin offering paid leave to workers sooner after being hired.
That will raise awareness of the credit, and it will expand the number of Americans who have paid leave.
More access to family leave will contribute to that goal.
It is the paid family leave solution that will do the most good with the smallest pricetag.
This is how we expand paid family and medical leave for employees across this entire country.
Yesterday, we introduced the PFML Tax Credit Extension and Enhancement Act.
So I urge my colleagues to join me in pushing for this legislation's inclusion in this year's tax package.
I am determined to get this done, and I hope my colleagues will join me.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Illegitimate Court Counteraction Act (Executive Session)
statements.title: Illegitimate Court Counteraction Act (Executive Session)
sentences: It has been 480 days since Hamas's unprovoked attack; 480 days since Hamas brought brutal terror on Israel and the citizens of more than 30 countries; 480 days since American family members and friends were kidnapped.
Last year, the International Criminal Court issued an arrest warrant for Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu and his former defense minister.
The ICC has forgotten the hell Hamas inflicted on Israel and many other nations.
And now, it has alleged that Israel has committed war crimes.
Meanwhile, the tribunal conveniently turns a blind eye to atrocities in China, hiding behind the excuse of nonmembership, despite the fact that neither the United States nor Israel are members.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: INAUGURAL CEREMONY
statements.title: INAUGURAL CEREMONY
sentences: The Associate Justice of the Supreme Court, BRETT KAVANAUGH, administered to the Vice President-elect the oath of office prescribed by the Constitution, which he repeated as follows: I, James David Vance, do solemnly swear that I will support and defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies foreign and domestic; that I will bear true faith and allegiance to the same; that I take this obligation freely, without any mental reservation or purpose of evasion; and that I will well and faithfully discharge the duties of the office on which I am about to enter.

The Chief Justice of the Supreme Court, JOHN G. ROBERTS, JR., administered to the President-elect the oath of office prescribed by the Constitution, which he repeated, as follows: I, Donald John Trump, do solemnly swear that I will faithfully execute the office of President of the United States and will, to the best of my ability, preserve, protect, and defend the Constitution of the United States.

Almighty God, your profit Jeremiah walked the streets of Jerusalem and blessed its inhabitants with: (English translation of statement made in Hebrew as follows:) Blessed is the one who trusts in God.
Hear the cry of the hostages, both American and Israeli, whose pain our President so acutely feels.
We are so thankful for the three young women who yesterday returned home and pray that the next 4 years brings peace to Israel and throughout the Middle East.
May our Nation merit the fulfillments of Jeremiah's blessing, that like a tree planted by water, we shall not cease to bear fruit.

We pray that we would fulfill the true meaning of our creed that ``We hold these truths to be self-evident that all men are created equal.'' We pray that You use our President; that we would live in a nation where we will not be judged by the color of our skin but by the content of our character.
But, God, we are asking You not only that, ``Let freedom ring from Stone Mountain Georgia!

And when we let freedom ring, we will be able to speed up that day, where all of your children, Black men and White men, Protestant and Catholic, Jew and Gentile, will be able to sing in the meaning of that old Negro spiritual: Free at last, free at last.
Let us go forth now with these words of President Trump's emblazoned on our hearts: As long as we have pride in our beliefs, courage in our convictions, and faith in our God, then we will not fail.
